name: agent-plugins
description: Incremental Markdown codebase maps for Codex sessions

interface.shortDescription: Reuse Markdown codebase maps across Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Agent Plugins captures project paths explored during a session, asks an Agent to incrementally maintain a linked Markdown codebase map, and loads its concise index in later sessions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Navigate or update this project's incremental Markdown codebase map.
